preview.text: Kuwait faces Qatar in a T20 match at Bayuemas Oval, where Qatar won the toss and chose to bowl first. In their 8 recorded T20 meetings, Kuwait won 5 and Qatar won 3. The forecast for the next 8 hours includes up to a 76 per cent chance of rain and about 29 degrees, with the usual first-innings score at the venue being 118 across 85 recorded T20 matches.

summary.text: Kuwait won by 58 runs. KUW made 199-7, Muhammad Umar top-scoring with 32 off 20 balls; Daniel Louis took 2 for 29. QAT made 133-8, Imal Liyanage (wk) top-scoring with 39 off 28 balls; Adnan Idrees took 2 for 22. Sides batting first at Bayuemas Oval usually make about 118.
